decisions.reason: As a prominently announced new product line with its own page, this app reflects a visible strategic commitment and recent sunk investment, so management is likely to continue and attribute any early issues to normal market adoption.

The education institute appears less central and less prominently committed than Product A, but given the very recent launch and invested setup effort, management would still be inclined to persist for now.

The remote support tool was publicly introduced and likely complements the firm’s established software and service business, which makes management likely to retain it at least another year despite any modest early uncertainty.
